name: Kisan Network
long_description:
Kisan Network is a tech enabled and fully integrated PAN India agri produce supply chain. We connect small and marginal farmers directly to businesses anywhere in the country, with each step digitally captured and monitored on our proprietary management portal. As a result, farmers are able to earn 10% more than prevalent market prices for their produce.

Our system, built on the 3 pillars of 
1) 100% integration
2) Standardisation w.r.t. on-field practices and,
3) Transparency for all stakeholders

is a departure from the opaque and inconsistent traditional supply chain which thrives on the high levels of fragmentation in the ecosystem. There is 0% use of paper in our entire chain, with specific focus on building a national agri repository of micro level stakeholder information and on image / data driven automated crop quality assessment.
one_liner: Tech enabled and fully integrated PAN India agri produce supply chain

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: A decade of experience in building companies, teams and products from scratch, both consumer and B2B, and scaling them to millions of $ in revenue and millions of users. Became one of the first India / Asia focused founders to be backed by both Y Combinator and Peter Thiel at the age of 22. Work covered by several media outlets such as TechCrunch, Forbes, Business Insider and the Economic Times.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: I started off in the early nineties and built a profitable company called Integrated Digital Systems. As a company specializing in Application technology, I conceived  and built along with my team very interesting applications in various fields like Geographic Information System; Rural distribution, Military Intelligence, War Gaming, Water Supply and Sanitation Project, 3D Task Trainers, Wireless Network Coverage etc. Co-founded Kisan Network and currently co-founder of Mera Gaon.
